description: This class provides service methods for managing 'Profesor' entities, including creating, retrieving, updating, patching, and deleting professors. It interacts with the ProfesorRepository for database operations and uses ProfesorDto for data transfer.

classes.name: ProfesorService
classes.description: Service layer for managing 'Profesor' entities, handling CRUD operations and data mapping.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Profesor entity from the provided DTO and saves it to the repository.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Profesor entities from the repository.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Profesor entity with new data and saves changes.

methods.name: patch
methods.description: Partially updates a Profesor entity's details and saves changes.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified Profesor entity from the repository.
